name: American Paint
notes: Pinto spotting: tobiano + sabino + frame overo + splash, all present. O/O (lethal white) is the real breeding hazard.
HYPP, HERDA and PSSM1 all have loci now - see SCN4A, PPIB and GYS1. HYPP is the breeding hazard here alongside O/O.

This is the APHA breed. A second intake draft arrived under the name 'Paint Horse (APHA)' asking for a separate apha_paint_horse alongside this file; it describes the same registry, the same 1965 merger and the same horse, so it was merged in here instead of shipped twice. Owner's call, 2026-09-15.

Two pools are now anchored to a measured study rather than to estimate. A study of inherited-disease allele frequencies in American Quarter Horse subgroups reports, for its control American Paint Horse group, an EDNRB/lethal-white allele frequency of 0.107 and an SCN4A/HYPP allele frequency of 0.025. HYPP moved to match it and is now several times its old rate - it had been carrying the mod's generic 1.2% carrier figure.

Frame did not move. An allele frequency of 0.107 gives about 19% carriers under Hardy-Weinberg, and the pool already sat at 20 - so the measurement corroborates what shipped rather than changing it, which is worth recording precisely because nothing had to be edited.

The same draft offered GBED, PSSM1 and HERDA rates. Those were declined: the draft labels all three as conservative Quarter Horse proxies rather than APHA figures, and the existing PPIB and GYS1 pools stay as they are. Only the numbers with a study behind them were taken.
